 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Overlay equal-sized binary masks, returning their intersection as 2s."""
    # Test instances present the two masks as a top block, separator, bottom block.
    # Demonstrations present masks side-by-side, separated by a column of 7s.
    if grid and all(7 in row for row in grid):
        div = next(j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j] == 7 for row in grid))
        left = [row[:div] for row in grid]
        right = [row[div + 1:] for row in grid]
        return [[2 if a == 1 and b == 9 else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)]
                for x, y in zip(left, right)]
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 3 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)]
            for x, y in zip(top, bottom)]
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
